snapshot.scope: Diagnostics support export accepts only an explicitly entered bounded private excerpt, redacts it before preview, and exports exactly the reviewed redacted text without automatic vault reads or uploads.

reviewers.task: Review explicit private support excerpt preview, redaction and exact export binding
reviewers.independence: Project review checks the user-visible preview and privacy boundary separately from the Main implementation and direct service tests.

dimensions.summary: The user explicitly enters and selects one bounded excerpt and sees the exact redacted text before any local export.
Schemas, Main lifecycle, export envelope and Settings use one paired optional-category and reviewed-excerpt contract.
PIGE-DIAG-002 cites direct redaction/export and Settings evidence while broader selectors and platform evidence remain open.
A private preview owner keeps diagnostics storage below budget and preserves legacy safe-bundle restart compatibility.
The existing diagnostics and privacy contracts already define reviewed optional excerpts, so no new design document is introduced.

verification.evidence: Direct tests prove legacy envelope compatibility, raw-text redaction, exact preview-bound export, and explicit Settings selection.

verification.command: npx vitest run tests/unit/schemas.test.ts -t "bounds optional diagnostics support categories" --maxWorkers=1
verification.evidence: The strict public schema pairs the private category with one bounded reviewed excerpt and rejects mismatched requests.

verification.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:architecture-reset
verification.evidence: The candidate compiles and builds while App and Diagnostics owners remain within protected architecture budgets.

coordination.taskTitle: Bind explicit reviewed diagnostics private excerpt
coordination.compatibility: Legacy safe support bundles without a private-excerpt exclusion row remain valid for restart reconciliation; no raw excerpt is retained.
coordination.acknowledgement: The optional private excerpt closes one PIGE-DIAG-002 slice while broader private-content selectors and platform/path evidence remain open.
